dc.bloqueo.tareas: There are only {n} tasks. At least 50 are needed.

ayuda.p1: Each team is compared with its own history, never with other teams. Normal is the range the measure falls in 70 weeks out of 100 over the last {r}.
ayuda.p2: The large figure is the last {k} weeks. It is compared with the previous {kp} to tell a real change from noise.
ayuda.p3: Some measures also have a fixed limit. If they go over it they turn red even within their range, and the card says so.
ayuda.p4: With fewer than 6 weeks of data there is no range. Between 6 and {r} the baseline is provisional: the figures hold, but the range can still move.
ayuda.p5: Click any indicator to see how it is worked out and the list of tasks behind the figure.

csv.jira1: Open the issue search (Filters, Advanced search) with the project and a year of history.
csv.jira2: Export: CSV (all fields) or Excel. Both are read.

csv.jira4: If you have the Time in Status column or the change history, include them: they give time per stage and rework.

csv.excel2: Rows above the column titles are skipped. Dates are read in the format of the file.
csv.excel3: If a needed column is missing, the page asks you to choose it once.
csv.nota: The files never leave this browser.

ob.welcome.titulo: Measure your teams' flow without blindly trusting the data.
ob.welcome.lead: easyperformance reads Jira exports, checks how far the data can be trusted and compares each team with its own history. Recommendations come with the evidence alongside.
ob.what1.d: Jira CSV exports, in this browser.
ob.what2.d: Each status mapped to a common one.
ob.what4.d: Ten checks before looking at figures.
ob.privacidad: Everything is worked out in this browser. The files never leave your computer. AI is optional and only receives figures already worked out.
ob.data.lead: One or more Jira exports, as CSV or Excel, with all fields. A year of history gives a solid baseline.
ob.data.soltar: Drop the CSV or Excel files here, or click to choose them
ob.rev.lead: Check that the teams are the ones you expect. You can change the team field, remove teams and mark vendors.
ob.mapeo.titulo: Check how the statuses are mapped
ob.mapeo.lead: Lead time and work in progress depend on this. Confirm or change those not mapped by name.
ob.context.lead: The answers decide which indicators make up the baseline and which recommendations apply.
ob.dc.lead: Before looking at figures: can this export support the analysis?
ob.dc.texto.ready: All baseline indicators can be worked out.
ob.dc.texto.limits: Some indicators cannot be worked out or reliability is not high.
ob.dc.texto.not_ready: With this data the figures would not be trustworthy.
ob.rol.lead: It decides what is shown first. You can change it at any time from the sidebar.
ob.rol.direccion: Overall state, where there is a problem with evidence and what to decide. No Jira jargon.
ob.rol.pmo: Data reliability, what to fix in how data is captured and which comparisons are valid.
ob.rol.equipo: The team's own flow against its baseline and what to do this week. No ranking.
ob.rol.cualEquipoAyuda: That team's page will open, without comparing it with the others.
ob.data.seguir: Continue with the loaded data ({n} tasks)
columnas.lead: Not all the needed columns are recognised in {f}. Say which of your columns is each thing: it is saved and will not need repeating for this client.
columnas.nota: Only the key and the creation date are required. Each extra column lets more be measured.
columnas.ayuda.clave: A unique code per task, like PROJ-123.
columnas.ayuda.resumen: Only to show the task; it never leaves the browser.
columnas.ayuda.tipo: Story, bug, task... Without it bugs are not counted.
columnas.ayuda.estado: Without it there is no way to know what is in progress.
columnas.ayuda.resuelta: Without it deliveries are not counted.
columnas.ayuda.equipo: Without it all work counts as one team.
columnas.ayuda.actualizada: Helps date the export and stalled work.
